annotation.authors_or_issuer: Group of Governmental Experts on Emerging Technologies in the Area of Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems, CCW (UN Geneva)
key_provisions_or_claims: GGE mandate continues to elaborate by consensus possible measures on normative and operational framework for LAWS
Proposals discussed: legally binding instrument, non-binding instrument, clarifying existing IHL, prohibit/regulate on IHL basis, or no new measures
Methods and means of warfare are not unlimited; UN Charter, IHL and ethical perspectives guide work
Internationally wrongful acts involving LAWS entail State responsibility; humans must comply with IHL
Recommends the GGE intensify consideration of proposals and continue its work
annotation.summary_en: Report of the 2022 CCW Group of Governmental Experts on lethal autonomous weapons systems. It records the mandate, organisation, participants and proposals discussed (binding, non-binding, IHL clarification, or no new measures), reaffirms IHL and State responsibility, and recommends continuing consensus-based work on possible measures.
